Finding: Uses JavaScript bitwise XOR (^) instead of exponentiation (**) in several position-variance and ANP formulas.
Proposed repair: Replace ^ with **, add numerical unit tests against published reference equations.
Test: Station range sweep and sensor-accuracy/ANP display checks.

Finding: Uses mutating GeoPoint.offset() on a shared origin passed to several GPS/VOR/DME sensor simulators; later sensors inherit prior noise.
Proposed repair: Copy position before offset or supply a separate GeoPoint output.
Test: Check original input unchanged and independent sensor outputs; no unexplained accumulation.

Finding: GPS receiver selection is assigned index+1 but publication adds 1 again.
Proposed repair: Publish activeGps without another increment; define behavior when none are valid.
Test: Force each receiver as best ANP and verify displayed ID.

Finding: DIST depends only on destinationFacility although it imperatively reads continuously changing pposSub; ETE and fuel/weight/endurance/range predictions inherit stale DIST.
Proposed repair: Map destinationFacility and pposSub together; use robust null and zero handling.
Test: Keep PERF open in flight: DIST and derived predictions change without navigation.

Finding: Same stale-DIST dependency as PERF; can distort predicted arrival fuel.
Proposed repair: Reuse shared validated distance/prediction service with position dependency.
Test: Keep FUEL page open: DIST and derived values recalculate.

Finding: onResume() triggers screen.navigateTo(/fuel#2) depending on current index, potentially reentering navigation. Reproduced symptom: cannot reopen after fuel initialization.
Proposed repair: Remove navigation from onResume; implement a non-recursive post-resume default subpage selection.
Test: Initialize FUEL, leave, return repeatedly from NAV, PERF and FPL.

Finding: Async plan changes are fired without awaiting; selections can launch overlapping edits and ignore insertArrival/insertApproach boolean failure.
Proposed repair: Serialize edits, await completion, verify active plan and display error on failure.
Test: Ground and airborne STAR/approach entry, rapid transition changes.

Finding: Similar nonserialized asynchronous procedure editing pattern to ARRIVAL; inspect exact event chain before patch.
Proposed repair: Use common flight-plan-edit transaction layer for SID and STAR, with completion and rollback.
Test: Rapid SID/runway/transition changes and in-flight reprogramming.

Finding: Insertion return status discarded; UI handlers return success without confirming new leg exists.
Proposed repair: Return/await real result and validate resulting flight-plan leg.
Test: Insert duplicate, invalid, airway, beginning and active-plan waypoints.

Evidence class: Confirmed source defect, runtime effect untested
Finding: The condition (index && ...) fails when index is zero, potentially bypassing preservation of the active target after an insertion.
Proposed repair: Use index !== undefined and identify active leg by stable reference when possible.
Test: Insert at index 0 before active waypoint while LNAV active; verify target unchanged.

Finding: An early rejection closes a batch using a constructed string instead of the UUID returned by openBatch.
Proposed repair: Close using returned identifier and wrap mutation in try/finally.
Test: Repeated failed inserts followed by successful modifications; inspect batch notifications.

Finding: Active plan is cleared before all imported components are validated; failures can leave a partial plan; some missing data are logged only.
Proposed repair: Stage/validate a candidate plan and commit transactionally or restore prior plan on failure.
Test: Inject missing facility/airway, abort mid-import; preserve existing active route.

Finding: Code comment says last enroute segment but searches segmentsOfType(Approach) while reconstructing imported direct-to.
Proposed repair: Use correct Enroute type, then verify DTO reconstruction semantics.
Test: EFB route import containing PPOS/direct-to with approach present and absent.

Finding: Global index modulo 12 rejects zero remainders (including first on each 12-item page); selection occurs relative to current page with no page-bound check.
Proposed repair: Find absolute match, validate page membership, convert to 1-based page-local index; verify inserted airway.
Test: Select first/last airway exit on each page by ident and number.

Finding: Wrapper anchors ETA to computer real-world midnight via Date.now(); core published SDK predictor supplies simulator UTC seconds-of-day.
Proposed repair: Use simulator clock to construct day anchor; define day rollover.
Test: Simulator date unlike OS date; midnight crossing, acceleration and replay.

Finding: Auto-naming counts existing prefix matches instead of finding first unused suffix; non-contiguous names can cause collisions.
Proposed repair: Use anchored matching and first available suffix 01..99; explicit exhaustion response.
Test: Facilities ABC01 and ABC03; repeated route imports.

Finding: Vertical-data LegEventType.Changed branch TODO; altitude edit sets speed constraint fields to unused.
Proposed repair: Preserve speed constraints, handle leg-data-change event and test UI refresh.
Test: Edit STAR altitude and verify speed restriction retained and displayed.

Finding: Merges duplicate legs by directly changing leg2.leg; source explicitly warns events will not fire.
Proposed repair: Change through flight-plan API with appropriate leg-changed notifications.
Test: Merge procedure/enroute duplicate and verify FPL and predictors refresh.

Finding: Async facility load does not verify destination is still the requested airport before publishing, risking old result after rapid changes.
Proposed repair: Use request token or compare current ICAO when promise resolves.
Test: Change destination twice under delayed facility resolution.

Finding: Six interface methods throw Not yet implemented; actual per-leg and destination predictions do function.
Proposed repair: Implement selectively when required; explicit feature gates, never call unimplemented methods in flight.
Test: Call each API in test harness; validate results and failure messages.

Finding: Flight-plan page contains TODO for ETA/ETE even though per-leg predictor exists and updates periodically.
Proposed repair: Bind existing predictions to conventional FPL display, respect original UI.
Test: Compare FPL leg ETA/ETE with NAV and simulation clock.

Finding: COMPRESSED, STORE FPL, CLEARANCE, PPOS TO WPT, RAIM PRED are explicitly disabled.
Proposed repair: Implement original Universal semantics one feature at a time; STORE FPL as pilot route database separate from active plan.
Test: Store/recall route without changing active route; view modes.

Finding: VNAV shows NOT AVAILABLE; TUNE is placeholder; neither is a minor bug fix.
Proposed repair: Preserve original page identity, introduce passive VNAV first, then optional active guidance after validation.
Test: VNAV advisory tests with STAR altitude constraints; approach glidepath regression.

Finding: ~40 message definitions but only one direct post call in current UNS source (NEXT_LEG_UNDEFINED). Defined alerts do not imply operational monitoring.
Proposed repair: Build event-to-message coverage matrix; add targeted alerts with suppression and priority.
Test: Provoke leg discontinuity, sensor degrade, predicted fuel warning.

Finding: GPS_ONLY_NAV message incorrectly renders GNSS 3 DESELECT; list dedupes on text and alphabetic-sort implementation contradicts timestamp comment.
Proposed repair: Correct text and order/dedupe by ID/priority or event time as appropriate.
Test: Post distinct same-text messages and check ordering and clearing.

Finding: LDA approach is labeled SDF; runway number validation inadvertently checks designator twice.
Proposed repair: Correct LDA label and validate runway number and designator independently.
Test: Display LDA and SDF procedures with runway identifiers.

Finding: Several truthiness checks treat legitimate zero values as unavailable, including PERF DIST/ETE and projected quantities.
Proposed repair: Use explicit null/undefined/finite tests, preserve zero.
Test: 0 NM at destination, exact zero fuel excess, 0 endurance.

Finding: Total true-air-miles accumulator initializes once and may persist across flights without full instrument reinitialization.
Proposed repair: Define flight-reset lifecycle and test same-simulator multiple flights.
Test: Fly leg A, land, taxi/takeoff B; inspect ESAD reset.

Finding: Generic pitch/VS/GP/GS and LNAV steering are present; this does not prove 707 custom pitch wheel or managed VNAV command is available.
Proposed repair: Document actual published 707/SDK interface before building active VNAV.
Test: Read-only steering command log; verify handoff and altitude capture.

Finding: UNS source excludes 707 virtual flight engineer implementation; standard SimVars are not proof that every custom switch and callout is observable.
Proposed repair: Build independent read-only telemetry logger; correlate VFE actions with exposed states.
Test: A/B ground tests VFE off/on, then safe airborne monitoring.
